disclosure: Synthetic challenge dataset. Not official BMC data. Contractors, amounts, dates, coordinates and transactions are fictional. Real Mumbai geographic names are used only for challenge realism.

false_positive_shields.statement: Normal rate variance, linked repeat visits and drainage/pumping work on DLP roads are deliberately not flagged as violations.

rate_card_variance_wo.why: Recorded cost is 2.28× the calculated rate-card expectation (positive variance ₹230,330, Excavation, pipeline repair, PQC patch)
rate_card_variance_wo.narrative: WO25-00611 is a road cave-in repair in ward B by Sahyadri Infra Works (fictional): excavation, pipeline repair and a PQC patch over 27.5 sqm, recorded at ₹410,330 against a rate-card expectation of ₹180,000. That is 2.28 times the expectation, or ₹230,330 above it, which puts it in the very-high variance review band. Two complaints are linked to it, so the work looks traceable; the question for the measurement book is why the recorded amount sits so far above the standard rate. This is a prompt for review, not a finding of wrongdoing.

duplicate_candidate_wo.why: Possible duplicate billing. Near-identical earlier work order WO25-01255 exists on RD0216 (Pump + debris removal, identical 2.8 sqm, 3.0d earlier). Review linkage and site evidence.
duplicate_candidate_wo.narrative: WO25-02486 raises a possible duplicate-billing question. It is a pump and debris removal job on RD0216 in ward L, recorded at ₹112,441 with no complaint linked, and it matches an earlier job on the same road, WO25-01255, in method and in area (2.8 sqm), three days earlier and with the same contractor. The costs differ by only about 0.55%. Neither the amount nor the method is unusual on its own; the pairing with no linked complaint is what makes it worth a site-evidence and linkage check. A duplicate candidate means please verify, not confirmed.

surface_dlp_wo.why: Surface repair was billed while the road was marked under DLP (resurfaced 2023-02-28). Contractual coverage and scope require review.
surface_dlp_wo.narrative: WO25-01723 is a road cave-in repair on RD0271 in ward S, recorded at ₹315,328 for excavation, pipeline repair and a PQC patch (30.3 sqm). The road was resurfaced on 2023-02-28 and is marked as still under its defect liability period, so a surface repair billed to the municipality may be something the original contractor should cover. That needs a contract and scope check, because DLP status alone does not prove liability. Separately, the amount is 1.75 times the rate-card expectation of ₹180,000.

unfixed_multilingual_complaint_near_hosp.why: Open hi complaint on RD0251, an ambulance-entry road for an emergency hospital; mentions ambulance: True
unfixed_multilingual_complaint_near_hosp.text: Vikhroli में पानी भर गया है, एम्बुलेंस नहीं निकल पा रही.
unfixed_multilingual_complaint_near_hosp.narrative: A Hindi complaint, BMC25-004589, logged on the MyBMC app in mid-August 2025, says that flooding at Vikhroli (ward N) is stopping an ambulance from getting through. Its GPS pin lies about 3 metres from RD0251, an ambulance-entry road for an emergency hospital, and 24 people upvoted it, yet it is still open with no work order linked. Its category is marked unverified because the Hindi wording is generic, but the ambulance reference makes it a good first case for a ward officer to check.

evidence.documented_normal_variance: DATA_DICTIONARY: normal jobs vary roughly 20 to 30% around the rate
evidence.decision: Locked at strictly > 1.30: every one of the 2,385 jobs <= 1.2997 sits inside the documented band; 114 jobs lie above it. Triage bands: REVIEW (1.30-1.60), HIGH_VARIANCE_REVIEW (1.60-2.00), VERY_HIGH_VARIANCE_REVIEW (>= 2.00). Calculated variance is not a finding of wrongdoing.

model_contribution_disclosure.text: Claude was used during development for multilingual interpretation and reviewed plain-language explanations grounded in deterministic PostGIS calculations. All monetary calculations, audit rules and rankings are deterministic and reproducible. The live demo works offline.

durability_labels.caveat: Not a cost per durable repair and not a long-term durability claim; incompatible unit groups are never ranked together.

experimental_accountability_index.name: experimental_accountability_index
experimental_accountability_index.status: EXPERIMENTAL - supporting view only; no letter grades; the primary evidence metrics above are what the UI leads with.
experimental_accountability_index.formula: 0.35*durability + 0.30*billing_integrity + 0.20*sla_vs_context + 0.15*dlp_adherence; durability = clip(75 - 2.5*delta_pts, 0, 100); billing = clip(100 - 4*flagged_share_pct, 0, 100); sla = clip(75 + 2*sla_vs_benchmark_pts, 0, 100); dlp = clip(100 - 3*dlp_surface_review_share_pct, 0, 100)
